steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: this task executes a predetermined 2x2 ablation using an already-selected biasing cell and existing fine-tuned checkpoint; no new literature validation is required.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: no new external tools, APIs, or facts are needed beyond what t0021-t0024 already established.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json ({} — no registered gold-92 metrics apply), costs.json, charts, and tables answering Q1-Q5.

steps.name: compare-literature

steps.name: reporting
